components.name: Primary action
components.html: Download FrameForge
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: .65rem; padding: .8rem 1.3rem; min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid var(--steel, #2A3140); border-radius: 5px; font-family: var(--sans, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: .875rem; line-height: 1.65; font-weight: 650; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .2s, background .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-button-primary svg { width: 1.15em; height: 1.15em; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--warm, #FFB383); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-primary { transition: none; } } .ds-button-primary { background: var(--ember, #FF7A2F); color: var(--obsidian, #0B0F14); border-color: var(--ember, #FF7A2F); box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgb(255 122 47 / 9%); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--hover, #FF914F); border-color: var(--hover, #FF914F); } .ds-button-primary:active { background: var(--pressed, #E96A25); }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Dark filled companion actions with steel outlines.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: .65rem; padding: .8rem 1.3rem; min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid var(--steel, #2A3140); border-radius: 5px; font-family: var(--sans, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: .875rem; line-height: 1.65; font-weight: 650; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .2s, background .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-button-secondary svg { width: 1.15em; height: 1.15em; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--warm, #FFB383); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-secondary { transition: none; } } .ds-button-secondary { background: #151b24; color: var(--text, #EDF1F7); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #222a36; border-color: #596276; }

components.name: Compact installation action
components.description: Quiet footer actions with the original button behavior.
components.css: .ds-button-compact { display: inline-flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: .65rem; padding: .8rem 1.3rem; min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid var(--steel, #2A3140); border-radius: 5px; font-family: var(--sans, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: .875rem; line-height: 1.65; font-weight: 650; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .2s, background .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-button-compact svg { width: 1.15em; height: 1.15em; } .ds-button-compact:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-compact:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-button-compact:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--warm, #FFB383); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-compact { transition: none; } } .ds-button-compact { background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #9DA7B8); border: 0; padding: .2rem 0; min-height: 32px; font-weight: 450; }

components.name: Range setting
components.description: Native adjustment control with a measured output and helper copy.
components.html: Distance inside the fixed clipping area.
components.css: .ds-range { font-family: var(--sans, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif); color: var(--text, #EDF1F7); line-height: 1.65; } .ds-range label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; font-size: .875rem; } .ds-range output { font-family: var(--mono, 'Cascadia Code', 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace); font-size: .75rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--warm, #FFB383); } .ds-range input { accent-color: var(--ember, #FF7A2F); width: 100%; min-height: 2.75rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-range p { color: var(--muted, #9DA7B8); font-size: .75rem; margin: 0; } .ds-range input:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .7; } .ds-range input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--warm, #FFB383); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Main navigation
components.description: Plain links with a clear current-page state.
components.html: FeaturesGuideAccount linkingSupport
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 1.7rem; font-family: var(--sans, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif); line-height: 1.65; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--muted, #9DA7B8); font-size: .875rem; padding-block: .7rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--text, #EDF1F7); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--warm, #FFB383); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Release metadata
components.description: A changelog link that records the actual version and alpha status.
components.html: FRAMEFORGE 0.1.7 ALPHA
components.css: .ds-release { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; font-family: var(--mono, 'Cascadia Code', 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace); font-size: .75rem; line-height: 1.6; letter-spacing: .045em; color: var(--muted, #9DA7B8); border: 1px solid var(--steel, #2A3140); border-radius: 30px; padding: .4rem .75rem; text-decoration: none; } .ds-release-square { width: 6px; height: 6px; background: var(--ember, #FF7A2F); } .ds-release-divider { height: 12px; width: 1px; background: var(--steel, #2A3140); } .ds-release:hover { color: var(--warm, #FFB383); } .ds-release:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--warm, #FFB383); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Feature surface
components.description: A shallow gradient and thin border contain feature explanation.
components.html:
Your layers.
Still your layers.

Supported frames, text, buttons, inputs, and layouts become native Roblox objects.
components.css: .ds-surface { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #151b24, #10151d); border: 1px solid var(--steel, #2A3140); border-radius: 8px; padding: 2.3rem; color: var(--text, #EDF1F7); font-family: var(--sans, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif); line-height: 1.65; } .ds-surface h3 { font-family: 'Manrope Variable', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1.7rem; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.12; letter-spacing: -.025em; margin: 0 0 1rem; } .ds-surface p { color: var(--muted, #9DA7B8); font-size: .9375rem; max-width: 430px; margin: 0; } @media (max-width: 580px) { .ds-surface { padding: 1.6rem; } }

components.name: Warm notice
components.html:
Changed artwork can need a fresh upload

After editing artwork, upload the new PNG and map its new key.
components.css: .ds-notice { padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; background: #201b19; border: 1px solid #6b4935; border-left: 1px solid var(--ember, #FF7A2F); border-radius: 5px; font-family: var(--sans, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif); line-height: 1.85; } .ds-notice strong { color: var(--warm, #FFB383); font-weight: 650; } .ds-notice p { color: #d5bdac; margin: .5rem 0 0; }

components.name: Masked interaction button
components.description: Stationary clipping mask with hover/focus stripe movement and 2D tilt.
components.css: .ds-masked-button { width: min(320px, 100%); min-height: 96px; background: var(--ember, #FF7A2F); border: 1px solid var(--warm, #FFB383); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--obsidian, #0B0F14); font-family: var(--mono, 'Cascadia Code', 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace); font-size: 1.65rem; line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 800; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgb(0 0 0 / 25%); position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1rem; transition: transform .32s ease; isolation: isolate; cursor: pointer; } .ds-masked-button svg { width: 1.15em; height: 1.15em; color: #4f220a; } .ds-stripe-mask { position: absolute; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 7px; z-index: -1; } .ds-stripes { position: absolute; inset: -200px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 0 30px, rgb(11 15 20 / 14%) 30px 55px); transition: transform .45s ease; } .ds-masked-button:hover, .ds-masked-button:focus-visible { transform: rotate(var(--button-tilt, -3deg)); } .ds-masked-button:hover .ds-stripes, .ds-masked-button:focus-visible .ds-stripes { transform: translateX(var(--stripe-distance, 48px)); } .ds-masked-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--warm, #FFB383); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-masked-button, .ds-stripes { transition: none; transform: none !important; } }

narrative.overview:
FrameForge places editable structure at the center of a quiet digital workbench. Obsidian ground, steel dividers, shallow graphite-toned surfaces, and concentrated ember actions make the interface feel precise and useful. The supplied transparent forge mark remains the identity anchor.

Open geometric display type gives the product a confident voice; plain sans text makes the guide and legal pages comfortable to read. Technical diagrams and an interactive masked stripe button explain the native hierarchy. The implemented world combines border-defined panels with restrained gradients and soft illustration shadows.
keyCharacteristics: One orange accent family against cool dark neutrals.
Large balanced headings and quieter reading text.
Steel rules, shallow corners, and generous section spacing.
Real HTML/CSS diagrams and controls that preserve structure.
Purposeful motion with keyboard, pause, and reduced-motion behavior.

rules.name: Ember Action
rules.body: Use ember for primary actions and meaningful conversion highlights; use its warm tint for links, focused outlines, and selected technical details.

rules.name: Technical Type
rules.body: Reserve monospace for code, hierarchy, measurements, version metadata, and functional interface labels. Lead sections with their actual heading.

rules.name: Quiet Depth
rules.body: Use tonal surfaces and steel borders for ordinary content. Keep soft shadows and faint ember glow attached to actions or the conversion illustration.

dos: Do retain the supplied transparent FrameForge mark and the dark steel / ember identity.
Do use Manrope for headings, plain sans for reading, and monospace for technical content.
Do use border-defined surfaces and shallow corners, matching the component tokens.
Do stack diagrams and controls on narrow screens so labels and hierarchies remain readable.
Do preserve warm visible focus, native control semantics, motion pause, and reduced-motion support.
Do keep explanatory interfaces editable as HTML/CSS with inline SVG for interface icons.
donts: Don't introduce purple into the established palette.
Don't add decorative kickers above section or document titles.
Don't turn illustration-specific small typography, rotated windows, or grid texture into ordinary reading styles.
Don't flatten the conversion exhibit or interaction preview into a screenshot.
Don't replace the supplied logo or place an opaque backing inside its transparent asset.
Don't add continuous motion without the existing visibility, pause, and reduced-motion behavior.
